name: Sky Savings USDS
oneLiner: sUSDS is the yield-bearing wrapper of Sky's USDS; the exchange rate compounds with the Sky Savings Rate, with USDS-tier CDP risk underneath.
collateral: USDS deposited into Sky's ERC-4626 savings vault; the wrapper remains fully backed by USDS while the exchange rate compounds with the Sky Savings Rate
pegMechanism: Deposit USDS to mint sUSDS and withdraw USDS directly from the vault with no protocol fee; sUSDS and sDAI are both savings wrappers but are not exchangeable 1:1 because they have accrued different amounts of yield

oracleRisk.summary: sUSDS is an ERC-4626 savings wrapper over USDS and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or local liquidation engine. Its required USDS parent carries the separately reviewed Sky Vault oracle, auction, backstop, and bad-debt branch.

branchApplicability.rationale: Sky documents sUSDS as an ERC-4626 savings token whose users deposit USDS for shares and withdraw USDS without protocol fees. It does not originate borrower debt or operate collateral-ratio-triggered liquidations. The variantOf relationship preserves the complete USDS parent branch review.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: All four tracked routes were reviewed separately. Ethereum 0xa3931d71877c0e7a3148cb7eb4463524fec27fbd is an EIP-1967 UUPS proxy: at block 25535646 it returned implementation 0x4e7991e5c547ce825bdeb665ee14a3274f9f61e0, with wards(MCD_PAUSE_PROXY 0xBE8E3e3618f7474F8cB1d074A26afFef007E98FB)=1 and wards(0x36b072ed8afe665e3aa6daba79decbec63752b22)=1. The verified current ERC-4626 source has ordinary transfer and transferFrom paths, no blacklist, pause, seizure, or transfer hook, and burns another holder's shares only with that holder's allowance; pinned zero-value transfer and transferFrom simulations returned true. Base 0x5875eee11cf8398102fdad704c9e96607675467a and OP Mainnet 0xb5b2dc7fd34c249f4be7fb1fcea07950784229e0 are separately verified UUPS representations: their current sources also have ordinary ERC-20 transfer paths, while their active ward pairs respectively include 0xdd0bcc201c9e47c6f6ee68e4db05b652bb6ac255 and 0xee44cdb68d618d58f75d9fe0818b640bd7b8a7b7 on Base, and 0x10e6593cdda8c58a1d0f14c5164b376352a55f2f and 0x8f41dbf6b8498561ce1d73af16cd9c0d8ee20ba6 on OP. At pinned blocks 48650092 and 154245377, their implementation and zero-value transfer/transferFrom calls succeeded. Arbitrum 0xddb46999f8891663a8f2828d25298f70416d7610 returned implementation 0x5aee6b37d6e31860804575aee3e2f368a0a428e7 at current head 483995500; its two active wards are 0x10e6593cdda8c58a1d0f14c5164b376352a55f2f and 0x13f7f24ca959359a4d710d32c715d4bce273c793, and current zero-value transfer paths returned true. The free Arbitrum endpoint rejected later fixed-block simulations as archive-only. Each live implementation authorizes UUPS upgrades through a ward, so a governance-controlled ward can replace holder-facing logic even though no active deployment currently exposes a direct holder blacklist or global transfer stop. Sky's parent repository, terms, transparency, and archived shutdown materials do not establish an additional live sUSDS holder-control function. Possible is retained for those route-specific live upgrade paths, not as a claim that one route's authority operates another route.

mintAuthority.summary: sUSDS is Sky's ERC-4626 savings wrapper over USDS. Vault share minting is backed by deposited USDS and inherits reviewed USDS_JOIN plus Sky governance authority for base supply.

controls.label: Sky Savings USDS vault
controls.capDescription: ERC-4626 share accounting over deposited USDS; does not mint base USDS.
controls.evidence: Local metadata marks sUSDS as `variantOf: usds-sky` and `variantKind: savings-passthrough`. At Ethereum block 25295174, EIP-1967 admin slot = 0x0 (no external proxy admin; UUPS pattern) and impl slot = 0x4e7991e5c547ce825bdeb665ee14a3274f9f61e0 (implementation confirmed). wards(MakerDAO PauseProxy 0xBE8E3e...) = 1: Sky governance is the upgrade authority.

controls.label: Inherited USDS_JOIN token adapter
controls.capDescription: Inherited USDS_JOIN minting is bounded by the reviewed USDS adapter/accounting path; sUSDS share minting itself does not create base USDS.

review.evidence: sUSDS is a savings wrapper over reviewed USDS. Vault share minting is separate from base USDS issuance. At Ethereum block 25295174: EIP-1967 admin slot = 0x0 (no external proxy admin), impl slot = 0x4e7991e5 (UUPS), wards(MakerDAO PauseProxy)=1. Upgrade authority is Sky governance via the wards mechanism. Wrapper has no privileged mint surface.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: sUSDS is the ERC-4626 savings wrapper for USDS and its multichain route is tied to Sky/Spark cross-chain liquidity plus Sky's Wormhole NTT expansion. Because NTT/OFT-style routes introduce an external messaging and token framework, Pharos scores the wrapper as external lock/mint exposure.
